sumber: DSKP Bahasa Inggeris KSSR (Semakan 2017, CEFR) Year 2; unit themes of the Year 2 textbook

nota.t: Monday · Tuesday · Wednesday · Thursday · Friday · Saturday · Sunday

I play football on Mondays. · I go swimming on Saturdays.
Do you play the piano on Sundays? — Yes, I do. / No, I don't.

glosari: The time when you are not at school or working.

nota.t: bedroom · bathroom · kitchen · living room · dining room · garden
There is a bed in the bedroom. (one) · There are two chairs in the kitchen. (more than one)
in · on · under · behind · next to · between

glosari: Things in a house like tables, chairs and beds.

nota.t: Do you like this hat? — Yes, I do. · Do you like these shoes? — No, I don't.
He's wearing a blue T-shirt. · She's wearing a red dress.
We say a pair of trousers / shoes / socks.

glosari: To have clothes on your body.

nota.t: head · arm · hand · fingers · leg · knee · foot · toes

I can jump. · A fish can't walk.
Can you swim? — Yes, I can. / No, I can't.
one foot → two feet · one tooth → two teeth

glosari: To be able to do something.

nota.t: sea · sand · shell · sun · boat · bucket · spade · sandcastle
Let's play in the sand. — Good idea! / Sorry, I don't want to.
Where's the ball? — It's under the umbrella.

glosari: A place with sand next to the sea.

nota.t: most words + s: cat → cats · words ending in s, x, ch, sh + es: box → boxes
Special plurals: child → children · man → men · woman → women · mouse → mice
he (a boy) · she (a girl) · it (a thing or animal) · they (more than one)
his book · her bag · our school · their house

glosari: The form of a word for more than one, like cats.
A word used in place of a name, like he, she, it.

nota.t: sh – ship, fish · ch – chair, lunch · th – three, bath · ee – tree, bee · oo – moon, book
Words that end with the same sound rhyme: cat – hat, tree – bee, night – light.

glosari: Two letters that make one sound, like sh, ch, th.
Words that end with the same sound.
